People will be resurrected barefoot, naked and uncircumcised, Abraham clothed first; some companions will be taken aside as renegades, and the Prophet will answer in the words of Jesus.
The Prophet will raise his head first after the second trumpet and see Moses hanging on the Throne; forty separate the two blasts, and bodies are rebuilt from the coccyx.
Forty separate the two trumpet blasts; then Allah sends rain, bodies grow like plants, and each is rebuilt from the coccyx, the one bone that does not decay.
When Allah sends punishment upon a nation it strikes all its people, and they are then resurrected according to their deeds.
